additional_info.body:
Dear RC-FR Team,
We have analyzed the AWS logs over the past month and identified that the issue is related to the converter, which is experiencing an internal communication error.
To resolve this, we recommend replacing the faulty converter (Serial Number: 2102312VGQKXN9001243SA002204000204FW with a new unit.
P
art details of rectifier - 8EM5903-0AA01-0AA2
Regarding the RCD FB3 error, we suggest resetting the RCD if it is tripping. Additionally, it is important to investigate the root cause of the RCD tripping, which may involve troubleshooting the downstream components, as depicted in the diagram below.
